name: Modality Of Counting 1 Code
definition: Specifies the modality through which the votes that have been recorded and counted.

EVAM.name: Electronic At Meeting
EVAM.definition: Electronic vote recorded and counted at the meeting.

EVBM.name: Electronic Before
EVBM.definition: Electronic vote recorded and counted ahead of the meeting.

PVBM.name: Paper Before
PVBM.definition: Paper vote recorded and counted ahead of the meeting.

PVAM.name: Physical At Meeting
PVAM.definition: Physical attendance with vote at the meeting.
